before: A metafile picture that stopped at a malformed record reported metafile-limit, and the font notice counted faces that only hidden runs used.
after: A malformed record reports metafile-record; metafile-limit means a resource bound. Hidden runs do not add faces to the font notice.
reason: Both changes only read the document: PDF export diagnostics and a local font notice derived from the tree. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged.
